(2) Product Description                                                                                   Qty.

Transformers 1500W                                                                                       360

Carbon Monoxide (CO) / Methane Detectors                                                200

Dehumidifiers                                                                                                   150

(3) Minimum Requirements Transformers

Portable single-phase autotransformer

Power: 1500 VA

Input voltages V1: 220 V

Outputs voltage V2: 2x 110 V protected by Ground Fault Interrupter 15 A 125 V Class A

GFI’s will be provided of TEST and RESET buttons, and light of voltage presence

Frequency: 50-60 Hz

Autotransformer enclosed in thermoplastic box self-extinguishing V0

Input provided, replaceable protection fuse, 1,5mtr of cord with Italian standard Plug, hand lift enclose  

Dimensions in mm: w240 cm x d185 cm x h175 cm (+/- 5cm)

CE Certified, Certification to be provided with Transformers

Material to be delivered palletized (Max 24 per pallet)

(4) CO and Methane Detectors Minimum Requirements

Power supply 230V/50Hz Italian Plug (portable)

Detected gas: Methane (CH4) - Carbon Monoxide (CO)

Operation/Alarm/ Failure Indicator Leds

Case material ABS/VO

Power absorption 6V

Alarm buzzer

Activation delay maximum 1 minute

Sensor lifetime 5 years

Protection Grade IP42

Operating temperature 0-40 degrees

CE certified, Certification to be provided with CO/Methane Detectors

Material to be delivered palletized (Max 100 per pallet)

(5) Minimum Requirements Dehumidifiers

Weight: approx. 10/15 Kg.

220V/50Hz

Dimensions: w30/40cm x d20/30cm x h50/60cm

Moisture removal: 20 liters

Water tank capacity: 4.5 liters

Noise level 40/42dB

Refrigerant R290

Features: Filter cleaning alarm signal. Touch control panel.

Best for: Indoor spaces between 20/30 mq with room temperature from +5 C to +32 C degrees.

Air flow volume minimum 170 mc/h

CE Certified, Certification to be provided with Dehumidifiers

Material to be delivered palletized (Max 12 per pallet)

 (6) Delivery:

The contractor shall provide all materials on pallets and transportation to the Housing Warehouse within two months (60 days) from the award date. The regular working hours of the U.S. Government are 0730-1600 Monday through Friday; however, times shall be coordinated with the Government point of contact cited below. Technical Evaluation shall be based also on past performance.
